core15.existing_limit: Only exact Listing page and clock SQL are admitted; no selector/companion queries. This minimum is not the complete read producer.

read_selector_required.proposed_signature: selectCurrentUnitPropertyForReadV1(liveReadScope, opaqueHostObservation, {property_id,unit_id}) -> current canonical Unit/Property binding or bounded denial
read_selector_required.existing_command_preconditions: Real command_id/command_aggregate portfolio.unit lock and post-lock authority receipt. A read UUID cannot be relabelled as command authority.
read_selector_required.required_source_change: Core adds read-compatible selector/capability and explicitly admits its exact SQL. Keep existing command selector/authority engine intact.

canonical_required.adaptation_required: Core15 must supply real read-compatible binding; legacy bindSelector cannot be satisfied by fabricated command receipts. AIRPROP adapts the consumer after the actual ABI arrives.
canonical_required.current_resolver_limit: Only Unit/core.units.identity.read/core.unit_identity.history is implemented. airprop.asset.read/airprop.portfolio.read or manage/airprop.b2 requests are withheld. Do not relabel permission or evaluated_at.
required_output: current official party and ownership/management/representation relationship/version
canonical_required.action_projection: Separate current per-Listing/action manage producer; absent => unavailable, never derive from read or bridge availability.
canonical_required.timestamp_requirement: Real DB time after waits, preserve microseconds; no statement-start observation presented as fresh clock and no invented TTL.

principal.authentication: Existing Supabase SSR getUser + verified getClaims; matching sub/session_id/exp/aal/authenticated role; canonical session/tenant/Context/Workspace resolution on server
principal.manage: airprop.opportunity.manage / airprop_commercial / airprop.b2 with AAL2 and current investment property mandate
principal.authority_after_wait: Canonical C01/current session/revision participation for every writer/revocation/expiry and final disclosure. SERIALIZABLE alone is not proof.

c03_required.input: Verified actor/Context/Workspace, real authority revision, immutable original command identity/key/fingerprint, exact resource/party/relationship/version and Opportunity binding for publish
c03_required.existing_control_consumer: ListingControlBridge(actorId, ListingCommand) -> receipt | denied | conflict | not_ready | unknown_commit
c03_required.publication_gap: Current Listing transport/component contains lifecycle only; official resource/party picker and durable publish integration must be added after the canonical source/command ABI is delivered, not replaced by a synthetic form.
c03_required.receipt: Actual Core immutable receipt plus validated native domain receipt tied to the original full selection/body. Domain row, local callback or GET200 is not commit evidence.
c03_required.retry: Core must provide original durable command/transaction/authority preconditions for same-key retry, current reauthorization and exact persisted replay readback. Do not mint new IDs, rotate keys or reconstruct authority from a historical receipt.
c03_required.unknown: Unknown COMMIT preserved; original frozen command kept; explicit reconciliation, no blind resend or duplicate effect.

platform12.target: Verified owned isolated persistent development PG/Auth target with synthetic data only; no populated staging or Production
platform12.version_required: Exact PostgreSQL/schema migration/profile/driver identities and compatibility with Shared Base/Core15; PG17 expected by existing proof request, not observed installed
platform12.connection: Role-scoped pg physical checkout preserving backend/session/COMMIT/cleanup semantics; existing server Supabase SSR Auth; private secret bindings supplied outside source/logs, no browser connection or service_role
platform12.principal: Explicit admitted executor/runtime role graph; no superuser/BYPASSRLS/CREATEROLE/CREATEDB/REPLICATION, no privileged inherited path. Existing Core minimum rejects postgres/supabase_admin/service_role/anon/authenticated/authenticator profiles.
platform12.privilege_rule: SELECT/row-lock and schema USAGE only where actual direct-query closure requires them; specific reviewed EXECUTE only; C03/domain writes only through admitted Core/domain writer path with RLS/session checks. No blanket grants/default ACL change and no grants executed by this packet.
platform12.persistence: Owned named development volume, explicit reset/backup custody; fixture runs separated from product data and restart retains committed rows/receipts
platform12.readiness_observed_here: Docker28.4.0 responds; image/container inventory empty; no Supabase CLI or configured runtime/credential binding. This is neither ready Backend nor prohibition on later authorized bootstrap.
platform12.bootstrap_authority: Owner permits required isolated synthetic development construction/execution after official Platform12 profile delivery and target verification.

remaining_connected_acceptance: official resource/party selection -> publish -> committed Listing
read/edit/withdraw and readback after browser reload plus process/DB restart
foreign Workspace denial and zero writes
same-key concurrent retry and unknown commit recovery without duplicate effect
real server RLS and role-scoped issued Auth
